popCulture.title: Polyphemus
popCulture.description: The Cyclops who believed Nobody remains Odyssey 9's indelible monster — the blinded giant shouting to his brothers from the shore.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.description: Polyphemus' cave is still the schoolroom image of cunning versus force — the stake, the wine, and the name that is no name.
